statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management
The diagnosis codes are I49.5, I48.91, and R55
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service has been rejected because this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
